title: Project Budget Overrun Probability
scenario: Identify projects where the sum of employee salaries exceeds the project budget. Return the result table as 'project_id' and 'overrun_amount'.
tableSchema: projects (project_id INT, start_date DATE, end_date DATE, budget INT), employees (employee_id INT, project_id INT, role VARCHAR, salary INT)
hint: Join projects and employees on project_id, group by project_id, and filter where SUM(salary) > budget.
correctQuery: SELECT p.project_id, (SUM(e.salary) - p.budget) AS overrun_amount FROM projects p JOIN employees e ON p.project_id = e.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id, p.budget HAVING SUM(e.salary) > p.budget;
